If you play "QUICK WINS" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
1919.headline: How much has sold

1921.body:
"$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" has 318,899 prizes of a free ticket still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $10,000 prize, with three left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1921.headline: A close look at the prizes

1927.body:
"CASH SCRATCH FEVER" has joined the Georgia lineup at $5 with three top prizes of $400,000. Only on the first day do the overall odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

If "CASH SCRATCH FEVER" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
1927.headline: New in stores

1929.body:
"Cheers 2027" is down to fifteen top prizes after a $20,027 winner was claimed two days ago. The game started with seventeen top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

Everything here about "Cheers 2027" comes from official Georgia lottery numbers, current through November 24.
1929.headline: Top prize count went down
